bei.settings.title: BEI Settings
bei.project.title: Master Project
bei.project.none: No Master Project. Hover an item and press P.
bei.settings.browser.tip: Show the item browser along the right edge.
bei.settings.tray.tip: Show the category icons beside the item grid.
bei.settings.hud.tip: Show the Master Project readout in the game view.
bei.settings.corner.tip: Click to move the project readout to the next corner.
bei.settings.ender.tip: Count items in your ender chest as already owned.
bei.settings.opacity.tip: Drag to change how solid BEI's panels are.
bei.settings.columns.tip: Columns of items (needs custom grid size on).
bei.settings.rows.tip: Rows of items (needs custom grid size on).
bei.settings.open_project.tip: Open the full Master Project tree.
bei.tip.project_set: Make this item your Master Project
bei.settings.slot_bg.tip: Draw a dark box behind each item in recipes.
bei.settings.card_bg.tip: Draw a panel behind each recipe in the recipe popup.
bei.settings.custom.tip: Use the columns and rows below for the item browser and recipe ingredients.
bei.settings.browser_bg.tip: Draw a backdrop behind the item browser. Off leaves just the items.
bei.tip.autofill: Put these ingredients in the crafting grid (Shift: as many as you have, up to a stack)
bei.tip.transfer: Fill the open screen with these ingredients
bei.tip.transfer_keys: Shift: a full stack. Ctrl: as many as possible.
bei.settings.theme.tip: Click to switch theme. Datapacks can add more.
bei.settings.cheat_target.tip: Where cheat mode puts clicked items. Click to switch.
bei.cheat.on: Cheat mode ON: click items in the browser to get them
bei.cheat.no_server: This server does not have BEI, so cheat mode can't give items
bei.recipes.no_server: This server does not have BEI, so it sends no recipes.
bei.group.hint: Hold Shift to pick an item
bei.station.craftable: You can make some of these
bei.tip.project_recipe: Make this recipe your Master Project
